items.title: Sweet Williams Interview
items.q: My boy, the hell of a piano player, Arnold Wiley... I knew him.

ctx.x: Did you know Arnold Wiley? Yes, I knew him.

Yeah? He's from Arkansas. He's the last time I was in Detroit. My boy, the hell of a piano player, Arnold Wiley. Look skinned, fella. Talked real soft. A little bit of head, light brown, chin light at me. Arnold Wiley, do I know him? He's from Arkansas.
Yeah, he's from Arkansas. Yeah, he's from Arkansas.
